subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The WannaCry Pandemic
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The WannaCry Pandemic.

hook.text: In May 2017, a worm encrypted computers in 150 countries within hours. Hospitals couldn't access patient records.

buildup.text: WannaCry used a leaked NSA exploit called EternalBlue to spread through unpatched Windows systems.

discovery.text: A 22-year-old researcher accidentally found the kill switch — a domain name that stopped the worm's spread.

twist.text: The NSA had known about the vulnerability and kept it secret as a weapon. Then it leaked.

climax.text: WannaCry showed that government-hoarded exploits become everyone's problem when they escape.

punchline.text: A spy tool leaked. A worm hit 150 countries. A kid stopped it.

quiz.question: How was WannaCry stopped?
options: A researcher found and activated a kill switch domain
The NSA deployed a patch worldwide
